claims.text: Env-shaped names in docs, mapped to `path:line` sites.

claims.text: Every env-shaped token in docs, however it is written.

claims.text: Count a bare doc mention as documentation for names the code truly reads.
claims.why: The function adds names from mentioned to documented if they are in read but not in documented, implementing the described behavior.

claims.text: docs/HANDOFF.md lists some variables as bare lines inside a fenced block, which matches no operator-shaped form. Requiring the strict form there would manufacture a 'read but never documented' finding for a name the docs plainly show, and the whole point of the drift list is that every entry is worth acting on.
claims.why: The docstring refers to docs/HANDOFF.md and 'operator-shaped form', but neither the file nor the patterns are present in this chunk.

claims.text: Computes documentation drift between documented and read names.
claims.why: The function produces DocDrift entries for names in doc_names - read and read - doc_names, matching the drift computation description.
